name: Rajput Harshilsinh
title: Frontend Engineer
bio: I build fast, accessible, and beautifully animated interfaces — turning product requirements into production-grade React and Next.js applications.
summary: I'm a frontend-focused software engineer with three-plus years of experience shipping enterprise web applications end-to-end — from component architecture and state management to performance tuning and accessibility. I care about the details most teams skip: layout stability, animation timing, bundle size, and interfaces that hold up under real usage, not just in a demo.
philosophy: Component-driven, reusable architecture over one-off code
Performance and accessibility are features, not afterthoughts
Motion should clarify state, never distract from it
Scalable state management keeps large apps maintainable
